items.docs: Adds a role as a consumer of the specified queue. Consumer roles are assigned to bots that will process work items from the queue. Only users with queue management permissions can add consumers.

info.name: Add or update a queue member

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the queue

params.name: userId
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the user

items.docs: Adds a user as a member of the specified queue or updates the existing membership configuration. Queue members are human users who can manage queue operations such as reviewing failed items.

items.docs: Adds a participant to the specified queue. Participants can view queue status and work item data but have limited management permissions compared to queue owners or members.
